question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

Statement:

Severe congestion is seen on the service road outside the apartment complex between 7.30 a.m. to 9 a.m. everyday due to many school buses from different schools picking up children from gate of the apartment complex. This is leading to a traffic jam, delaying many people travelling for work at this time.

Courses of Action:

(I) No school buses should be permitted on the service road from 7.30 a.m. to 9 a.m.

(II) School buses should be permitted to enter the society gates.
